catalogMeta.label: Order Cards
catalogMeta.description: Arrange shuffled number cards from smallest to largest. Provide distinct numbers in sequence and the same set sorted ascending in correctAnswers. K uses 3-4 cards; Grade 1 uses 4-6.

fullData.title: Order the Number Cards!
fullData.description: Help the friendly animals put their number cards in the correct order from smallest to largest.

challenges.instruction: Can you put these numbers in order from smallest to largest?
Great job! Let's try three new numbers. Put them in order from smallest to largest.
You are doing wonderful! Can you order these larger numbers from smallest to largest?
